_comment: One-time seed applied on first run by apply_starter() in server.py. It only ADDS lines and swaps the untouched placeholder intro; it never edits or deletes what you write. Every note below is drawn from your own repo (projects/purple-luna-teaser/README.md) — nothing here is invented. GTA videos and Cat Instagram are left blank on purpose: there's nothing about them in the repo yet, so the coach will ask you to brief it. intro: I'm juggling a few things at once: Purple Luna and its clients, GTA videos, and a cat Instagram — and I keep having new ideas. Help me hold the whole picture, pick what matters most this week, and actually finish things instead of starting more. Be direct; don't let me over-polish or chase every shiny new idea.

The product, Luna, answers a business's WhatsApp in seconds and books customers 24/7 — zero commission, every booking stays theirs.
A 25.6s vertical teaser (purple-luna-teaser.mp4, for TikTok/Reels/Shorts) is built and cut to work silent with captions.
Before posting the teaser: swap the placeholder music for a track I'm licensed to use publicly.
